newsitem.title: CHINA: Pudong to provide opportunities in property market.
newsitem.headline: Pudong to provide opportunities in property market.

text.p: The property market in Shanghai's Pudong New Area will offer great opportunities in 1997 partly due to the move of financial markets and government departments to the area, the Business News said on Wednesday.

The Shanghai Cereals and Oils Exchange has moved to Pudong, and the Shanghai Stock Exchange and the Shanghai Commodity Exchange will move later this year, followed by other major markets before the end of the century, the newspaper said.

A number of city government departments including the Shanghai Housing and Land Management Committee, the Shanghai Foreign Trade Commission and Shanghai Foreign Investment Commission will also shortly move to Pudong.
"With Shanghai's traffic little improved so far, many companies and official departments are likely to buy property there to faciliate business and staff residence," the newspaper said.
It said the city government planned to greatly improve living conditions in Pudong, in particular in the Lujiazui Finance and Trade Zone, by expanding the amount of green space.
Shanghai has designated Pudong as a future regional financial centre, and is using adminsitrative means to speed its development.
Foreign banks in Shanghai wishing to do local currency business have been told they must move their offices away from central Shanghai into Pudong.
